scope.summary: Implement the edit_body MCP tool per Section 13.25: canonical wire name edit_body applies an RFC 7396 JSON merge patch to a BodySpec draft, decomposing channel edits into CRDT-safe per-channel ops while preserving channel isolation — a patch can never write outside its channel's declared region mask (REQ-002/003 enforcement on the API surface).
acceptance_criteria: edit_body implements RFC 7396 semantics exactly (null deletes a key, nested objects merge recursively, arrays replace) and passes a test vector set lifted from the RFC examples.
Channel-value changes inside the patch become per-channel CRDT LWW ops (MT-648 lane) with session attribution; non-channel BodySpec fields patch atomically on the draft.
Decouple enforcement re-runs on the touched channels: a patch whose applied deltas would exit the channel's region mask is rejected with a typed violation naming the channel and region.
Invalid pointers, out-of-range values (beyond designed over-range), and type mismatches return typed errors with suggested_fix JSON pointers instead of partial application.
Concurrent edit_body calls from two sessions on different channels of the same draft both land (CRDT merge test).
scope.risk_if_missed: Model editing either corrupts drafts under swarm concurrency or reintroduces hidden cross-region writes through the API back door, silently destroying the decoupling guarantee that is BodyKit's founding requirement.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
